artifact_hash_semantics: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes after CRLF to LF canonicalization, matching lucida.evidence_bundle._sha256.

attachment_recommendation.recommendation: Transfer exactly the three included artifacts as internal postulation evidence references.

operator_dependent: Any future live Resolume, audio, lighting, venue, hardware, camera, GPU, network, or transport validation.
prospective: Mathematical layout as a declared design axis, not measured physical geometry.
Future approved light and audio consumers.
verified: Recorded signal envelope validation and deterministic replay.
Proposal-only pending projection with explicit approval and reversibility.
Offline evidence and no external side effects.

included_artifacts.role: Machine-readable claim status, evidence references, limits, and verification commands.
Human-readable evidence-to-proposal mapping with verified, prospective, and operator-dependent boundaries.
Commit provenance, candidate scope, evidence hashes, reproducibility commands, and limitations.

manifest_commit_meaning: The containing commit is the child commit created from manifest_parent_commit; this manifest does not self-reference its own commit hash.

operator_action.next_step: Review the three artifacts at the proposed target path and keep them separate from runtime source.

candidate_package.reason: The transfer set intentionally excludes lucida source modules, tests, schemas, fixtures, and runtime dependencies.

commands_executable: JSON inspection and hash verification only
transfer_artifact_set.reason: The three artifacts are inspectable evidence references and are not an executable source package.

source_commit_meaning: Commit tree containing the exact canonical bytes of every included artifact; distinct from the later manifest commit.
